scripts.setup: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.check: npm run lint --prefix client && npm test --prefix client -- --exclude '**/*.integration.test.ts' && npm test --prefix server -- --exclude '**/*.integration.test.ts' && npm run build --prefix client && npm run build:companion --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
